notes: Encoded from EnviroAir's own page only. The page's sister/similar list (AIRCO, ARGO, Dunkirk, ECR, EMI, E-verter, Olsen, Oneida Royal, Pennco, RetroAire, Ultimate, Utica) is not stated to share this serial system, so no sisters are claimed and no usesStylesOf is set. Month letter mapping lives only in a chart image, so the style ships year + week with month null.

styles.era: 14-character serials incl. dashes: digit + 2 digits + letter + 4 digits + 2 digits
styles.notes: Page example 1-99-C-9305-10; normalized form 199C930510. Year = 3rd-4th character numerical digits: raw counting (incl. dashes) and digit-only counting agree, both give '99' -> 1999. Month = 6th character letter (C), chart-only in image Style-1_EMI-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png (the image filename on this page is the EMI one), held for the image pass, so month is null. Week = last two numerical digits ('10', valid 1-53).
